claims.claim: Moonshot AI scrapped a $150 million deal to access Nvidia Blackwell chips through a data center in Indonesia after a U.S. rule restricting remote access.
claims.episode_span: has scrapped a $150 million deal to reach Nvidia Blackwell chips through a data center in Indonesia
claims.source_title: China’s Moonshot AI Scraps $150 Million Deal to Access Nvidia Chips in Indonesia
claims.supporting_quote: Moonshot AI, the Beijing-based developer of the Kimi models, has scrapped a $150 million deal to access Nvidia Blackwell chips through a data center in Indonesia, after the U.S. this week announced a rule to restrict Chinese companies from accessing advanced chips remotely, according to two people with direct knowledge of the matter.

claims.claim: Moonshot had contracted with a Southeast Asian neocloud to rent Blackwell Ultra B300 chips starting as early as next year.
claims.episode_span: signed with a Southeast Asian neocloud to rent a sizable cluster of Blackwell Ultra B300 chips
claims.source_title: China’s Moonshot AI Scraps $150 Million Deal to Access Nvidia Chips in Indonesia
claims.supporting_quote: Moonshot signed the contract with a Southeast Asian neocloud to rent access to a sizable cluster of Blackwell Ultra B300 chips, starting from as early as next year, the people said.

claims.claim: Google priced Gemini 4 Neon at $3 per million input tokens, $0.15 cached, and $15 per million output tokens, with up to 1 million tokens of context.
claims.episode_span: priced it at $3 per million input tokens, $0.15 per million cached inputs and $15 per million output tokens
claims.source_title: Gemini 4 Neon: Google's new $3 AI model for coding
claims.supporting_quote: Google priced the model at $3 per million input tokens, falling to $0.15 for repeated (cached) inputs, and $15 per million output tokens.

claims.claim: Google said Gemini 4 Neon scored 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and ranked third.
claims.episode_span: scored 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, third overall
claims.source_title: Gemini 4 Neon: Google's new $3 AI model for coding
claims.supporting_quote: The company said Gemini 4 Neon scored 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its highest setting, ranking third overall behind larger and slower models, and ranked first on the same firm’s coding-agent index.

claims.claim: In Antigravity, Gemini 4 Neon’s SWE-sweep score rose from 12.8 percent to 39.0 percent versus a base shell.
claims.episode_span: SWE-sweep rising from 12.8 percent in a base shell to 39.0 percent in Antigravity
claims.source_title: Google Gemini 4 Neon triples its coding test results thanks to Antigravity environment
claims.supporting_quote: Google's new Gemini 4 Neon AI model solved 12.8% of the problems in the SWE-sweep programming benchmark when run in the base mini-SWE shell, but its performance increased to 39.0% when the same model was run inside the Antigravity environment.

claims.claim: Google AI Pro costs $19.99 a month in the US and Neon replaces Argon for those subscribers.
claims.episode_span: replaces Argon for Google AI Pro, $19.99 a month in the U.S.
claims.source_title: Gemini 4 Neon replaces Argon for Google AI Pro subscribers
claims.supporting_quote: Google AI Pro costs $19.99 a month in the US and €21.99 in Germany.

claims.claim: Starting next year, schools that turn off Google’s AI features will not have access to Search, and New York, Los Angeles and Chicago are considering alternatives.
claims.episode_span: schools cannot turn off Gemini-powered features without also losing Search
claims.source_title: The nation’s largest school districts consider ditching Google Search
claims.supporting_quote: Starting next year, schools will not have the option to disable Gemini-powered features without also disabling Search.

claims.claim: Amazon said distributed KV caching on ElastiCache for Valkey cuts self-hosted inference cost by up to 40 percent and time to first token by up to 80 percent.
claims.episode_span: cuts self-hosted inference cost by up to 40 percent and time to first token by up to 80 percent
claims.source_title: Announcing distributed KV caching for self-hosted LLMs with Amazon ElastiCache
claims.supporting_quote: Today, we are announcing the general availability of fully managed distributed KV caching with Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey, a new capability that cuts self-hosted large language model (LLM) inference costs by up to 40% and time to first token (TTFT) by up to 80%.
